answer: Resist sybils by binding every identity to one unique reachable contact — a messaging handle or email that must answer a challenge pulse each epoch, like a sonnet answering its own rhyme scheme. Minting a thousand personas is cheap, but each needs a distinct verifiable contact; the network cross-checks for contact overlap, and any farm sharing handles collapses into one reward share. On the horizon, every extra head costs a real contact to acquire and keep alive, making mass fabrication expensive and trivially detectable.
